none: PAS NLM-B0FF74: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), probably an irregular copy of the commemorative Constantinopolis issue, 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted head left. Obverse inscription: [CONSTANTINOPOLIS]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left on prow; the Victory is a bulbous figure. Diameter: 10.7mm, Weight: 0.70gms, die axis: probably 6
